label: 8.2b Hosted Fields
openQuestions: HF-02..HF-06: UAT test cards and decline/3DS triggers not documented in source skills
HF-01: session success status code not stated
HF-03: status code for reused token not pinned (400/422)
Worldnet hosted-fields equivalent: none documented in worldnet-reference (GoChip excluded)

scenarios.title: Hosted Fields session token created
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a server-side session token is issued for the hosted fields library.
steps: POST the hosted-fields-sessions endpoint with libVersion (four-part version from the Payroc create-a-payment-form guide) and scenario payment, new Idempotency-Key.
Return only the session token to the browser.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200/201 with a session token (valid 10 minutes). Bearer token is never exposed to the browser.
scenarios.pitfalls: libVersion must match the CDN script version and differs between UAT and production. Generate one session per checkout page load. Success status code is not stated in the skill.

scenarios.title: Hosted Fields tokenization then sale
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a single-use token from submissionSuccess is accepted by the payments API.
steps: Load the library and render fields with a valid session token.
Submit test card details; capture the token from submissionSuccess.
POST /v1/payments with paymentMethod singleUseToken and the token, channel web.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201 with paymentId; transactionResult.responseCode A. Success branch must accept every approval status (e.g. ready with A).
scenarios.testData: Use a Payroc UAT test card from docs.payroc.com (card number not documented in the source skills; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Single-use tokens are one-time and expire in 30 minutes.

scenarios.title: Hosted Fields single-use token cannot be reused
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a consumed single-use token is rejected.
steps: POST /v1/payments again with the same single-use token and a new Idempotency-Key.
scenarios.expected: Request rejected (4xx, skill lists 400/422); no second charge.
scenarios.pitfalls: Exact status code not pinned in the skill.

scenarios.title: Hosted Fields declined card
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a decline from a hosted-fields token is handled.
steps: Tokenize a card using the documented decline trigger.
Branch on transactionResult, not HTTP status.
scenarios.expected: Decline in transactionResult body; application shows a decline and requires a fresh session to retry.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)

scenarios.title: Hosted Fields save card (tokenization scenario)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a card can be saved via the tokenization session scenario.
steps: Create a session with scenario tokenization.
Submit the form; send the single-use token to POST /v1/processing-terminals/{processingTerminalId}/secure-tokens with source singleUseToken.
scenarios.expected: Secure token created (HTTP 201) with secureTokenId and token starting 296753.

scenarios.title: Hosted Fields sale with 3-D Secure
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies MPI authentication is carried into the payment from a hosted-fields token.
steps: After submissionSuccess, call the MPI endpoint with the single-use token.
Receive the result on the registered webhook; store mpiReference.
POST /v1/payments with threeDSecure gateway and mpiReference.
scenarios.expected: Webhook result A then payment HTTP 201.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Terminal must be enabled for 3DS and a webhook URL registered with Payroc support.

scenarios.title: Hosted Fields ACH payment
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies an ACH single-use token can be charged via the bank transfer endpoint.
steps: Render ACH fields (one payment type per page).
